note: XXVII Q1 (Midjourney): the cases on the ground replaced by the great square earth-box (Ian: they look like violin or guitar cases)

beats.text: Replace the small open box or case on the ground with the Count's great earth-box: a long, plain, rough-planked wooden chest the size of a coffin, straight sides and square corners, no curves, no lining, no handles or clasps, its flat lid knocked half off and lying askew, dark earth spilling out of it onto the snow. It must not look like a violin, guitar or instrument case, or a small trunk. Keep the people, the bridge, the castle, the light and everything else exactly as they are.
